stages.DISCOVER: locate correct endpoint/object and required operational inputs from the natural condition surface
stages.AUTHENTICATE: authenticate with supplied credentials without leaking them; an authenticated read succeeds
stages.CONSTRUCT: assemble a valid single effect-creating request with correct object/params/mode/nonce
stages.EFFECT: issue exactly one effect-creating request creating one sandbox-safe reversible object carrying the run nonce
stages.VERIFY: independent read-only verifier confirms the effect vendor-side within the bounded window
stages.RECEIPT: canonical hashed evidence receipt binds identity, journey, verification, integrity

effect_definition: durable vendor-side state change independently observable by a second read-scoped credential; a 2xx/SDK-return/agent-claim is NOT an effect

effect_requirements.two_or_more_distinct: duplicate failure (FALSE_SUCCESS if claimed, else EFFECT_FAILED)

verifier_policy.repeated_pagination_rows_vs_distinct_dup: same id across pages = artefact; two ids = duplicate failure; never collapse distinct effects
verifier_policy.stale_object_exclusion: by creation timestamp + nonce vs pre-run inventory snapshot
verifier_policy.temporal_boundary: capture server-time<->local-time at start; scope to [start, termination+window]
verifier_policy.nonce_correlation_field: vendor-appropriate writable field (reference/metadata/subject); if none, frozen deterministic unique attribute with pre-declared ambiguity
verifier_policy.idempotency: effect request carries idempotency key where supported; SDK auto-write-retry disabled; second create attempt halts run
verifier_policy.pagination: follow every page; count all in-window new objects incl wrong-nonce; incomplete/looping/reordered => UNKNOWN

synchronous_vendor_acceptance_recorded_a.meaning: 2xx + accepted/ok code + vendor-assigned id is positive evidence an effect was attempted and accepted
synchronous_vendor_acceptance_recorded_a.grading_effect: not PROVEN_SUCCESS alone, but FORBIDS absence-based FALSE_SUCCESS (see outcome taxonomy C-DENY/C-AUDIT)

observation_paths.path_disagreement: UNKNOWN + verifier_path_disagreement; never a failure grade; never FALSE_SUCCESS (an authenticated authoritative path observed the effect)
observation_paths.single_path_vendors: pre-declared in mapping; carry higher UNKNOWN risk by design, not a penalty
observation_paths.basis: R02 effect was confirmed on Postmark Activity, a surface distinct from the enumeration API the historical verifier used
